panels.title: Cancellation Rate

panels.description: Version the Policy control plane currently serves as active.
panels.title: Active Policy Version

panels.description: Lowest policy version across Gateway Pods. min() is deliberate: a single lagging Pod must be visible rather than averaged away.
panels.title: Gateway Loaded Policy

panels.description: Policy version loaded by the Automation Worker.
panels.title: Worker Loaded Policy

panels.description: Active version minus the lowest loaded version across all components. 0 means every component converged. Non-zero for longer than 30 seconds means a component is stuck on an old policy and should be investigated.
panels.title: Policy Version Drift

panels.description: Wall-clock time of the last successful publish or rollback. The query multiplies the exported Unix seconds by 1000 because Grafana renders dateTimeAsIso from milliseconds.
panels.title: Last Policy Publication

panels.description: Entry point to the private Policy Editor. Reachable only through kubectl port-forward; it is never exposed publicly.

options.content:
## [Open Policy Editor](http://localhost:8020/admin/policies)

Requires `kubectl port-forward deployment/automation 8020:8020`.

The admin key is entered in the editor and is never stored in this dashboard.

panels.title: Open Policy Editor

panels.description: Cumulative publish and rollback attempts broken down by outcome. rejected counts 409 conflicts and validation failures; degraded counts writes that landed with a degraded cache.
panels.title: Policy Publication Outcomes

panels.description: Rate of failed policy reloads per component and reason. A sustained non-zero rate means that component is serving Last Known Good instead of the published policy.
panels.title: Policy Reload Failures
